ORDINANCE CVIII OF 1996
ORDINANCE CVIII OF 1996
PAKISTAN ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION (THIRD
AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996.
An Ordinance to amend the Pakistan
Environmental Protection Ordinance, 1983
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
2nd November, 1996]
No.F.2(1)/96‑Pub.,
dated 2‑11‑1996.‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
President is hereby published for general information:
Whereas it is expedient to amend the Pakistan
Environmental Protection Ordinance, 1983 (XXXVII of 1983) for the purposes
hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is not in
session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it
necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may
be called the Pakistan Environmental Protection (Third Amendment) Ordinance,
1996.
(2) It shall come into force at once and shall
be deemed to have taken effect from the second day of September, 1996.
